title: Nabhold product and subscription domain identifiers and enumerations
description: Canonical identifiers and enumerations for Product, ProductVersion, ProductSubscription and EntitlementProjection (Technical Specification SS31, SS88, SS91). This package defines vocabulary only; nabhold/baobab-cp is the runtime authority that persists, evaluates and materialises these concepts into CapabilityGrant records.

productVersionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ProductVersion. Never derived from product_id or the version string.

subscriptionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ProductSubscription.

entitlementProjectionId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for an EntitlementProjection row.

productVersionSemver.description: Semantic version of a ProductVersion. Published versions are immutable; a change is a new version, never an in-place edit (mirrors ADR-BCP-005 SS114's rule for CapabilityComposition).

productLifecycle.description: Operational lifecycle of a Product or ProductVersion. Deliberately the same five values as capability/v1/domain.schema.json's capabilityLifecycle -- the concept is identical -- but declared locally rather than cross-referenced, since Product is not itself a Capability.

subscriptionSource.description: How a ProductSubscription came to exist. Distinct from, but the usual origin cited by, capability/v1's capabilityGrantSource=PRODUCT_SUBSCRIPTION source_reference.

entitlementProjectionStatus.description: Whether a subscription-to-capability-grant expansion row has been turned into a real CapabilityGrant yet.
